name: devdocs
description: DevDocs (devdocs.io) is a single site that bundles many API documentation sets. This CLI lists the available docs, fetches a doc's index of entries and categories, and retrieves documentation pages or full offline bundles as static JSON or HTML from documents.devdocs.io.

commands.name: list-docs
commands.summary: List every documentation set on DevDocs with its slug, version, release, mtime and size. Use the slug in the other commands.

commands.name: list-entries
commands.summary: List all entries (name, path, type) in one documentation set's search index. DevDocs search is done on the client against this list, so filter the result by name to search.

params.name: slug
params.description: Documentation slug from list-docs, e.g. git, css, javascript, html, dom, http, python~3.13 (versioned slugs use ~)

commands.source: E1 E4 E5 E6 E7 E8 E9 GET https://documents.devdocs.io/git/index.json

commands.name: list-types
commands.summary: List the categories (types) of one documentation set, with entry counts and slugs, e.g. 'Branching and Merging' for git or 'Elements' for html.

params.name: slug
params.description: Documentation slug from list-docs, e.g. git, html, python~3.13

commands.name: get-doc-home
commands.summary: Get the HTML home/overview page of one documentation set.

params.name: slug
params.description: Documentation slug from list-docs, e.g. git, python~3.13

commands.name: get-page
commands.summary: Get the HTML content of one documentation page, using the slug and an entry path from list-entries.

params.name: slug
params.description: Documentation slug from list-docs, e.g. git, css, javascript, python~3.13

params.name: path
params.description: Entry path from list-entries with any '#anchor' removed, e.g. git-merge, properties/flex, global_objects/array/map, library/json

commands.name: download-doc
commands.summary: Download the full offline bundle of one documentation set: a JSON object that maps each page path to its HTML. This can be very large.

params.name: slug
params.description: Documentation slug from list-docs, e.g. git, javascript

notes: DevDocs has no server-side search API. To search, run list-entries for a doc and match entry names on the client side (the site does fuzzy matching).
Entry paths can contain '#anchor' (e.g. library/json#json.dumps). Pass only the part before '#' to get-page; the anchor points to a section inside that page.
Entry paths can contain slashes (e.g. properties/flex). These must be sent unescaped in the URL.
Versioned docs use slugs like python~3.13 or angular~21. Get the slugs from list-docs.
The web app adds ?<mtime> to document URLs only to bust the cache. It is not required.
Nothing requires login, and there is no pagination.
